name: Endpoint-Sensitive Edge Attachments
definition: Let $R\subseteq\{0,1\}^{12}$ be the rooted 289-vertex ample factor with root $u=0$ and distinguished neighbor $v=2$. Set $A=R$, $D=\{u,v\}$, and on a disjoint private copy of the coordinates define $B_r=(D\times\{0\})\cup(\{r\}\times R)$ for $r\in\{u,v\}$.
parameters: $|A|=289$ and $|B_u|=|B_v|=290$; the two gluings have 577 concepts each after identifying the common edge.
properties: Both attachments are dismantlable ample and are exchanged by reflecting the shared coordinate. They have identical absolute and common-edge prescribed widths, yet gluing to $A$ at $u$ has positive width $s=\sigma(R;\{u\})$ and gluing at $v$ has width zero.
